description:
Return an image of the editor window, or of one dock, dialog or control: the last resort to look at the UI, never to pick click points. For scene views use summer_screenshot.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/ui-screenshot"}

max_size.description: Longest edge in pixels after downscale (engine default 1024, clamped 16-4096). Smaller is cheaper to look at; the result reports scale.

root.description: Same grammar as summer_ui_tree root — 'window' (default; the whole editor window), 'main', 'dock:<title|id>', 'dialog:<title>', 'path:<node path>'.

name: summer_ui_screenshot
title: Screenshot the editor UI
